text: All solutions Clearer purchase requests before quotes are compared. A request may lack a specification, or a supplier may omit a term. We design reviews that bring the documents and open questions together before the purchasing decision. Custom workflow design and development Inputs The purchase request, its specifications, supplier quotes and review requirements supplied by your team. Define which fields need comparing and the authoritative source for each value. The review file A request summary, a comparison of available specifications and terms, and a list of gaps and questions. The owner can trace each entry to its original document. An illustrative example A fictional supplier quote for work devices omits the warranty period. The comparison states: warranty not provided. The next step is to request that information before comparing the quotes. Decision and acceptance Evaluate gap detection, accurate transfer of prices and terms, and source links. The authorized owner retains purchasing approval and any commitment to terms. Prepare a purchase review brief

All solutions Check the invoice context before preparing a follow-up. A payment may be recorded elsewhere, or a claim may be disputed. We design workflows that gather invoice status and recent communication so the owner can choose the appropriate follow-up. Custom workflow design and development Required information Invoice and payment records, due dates, prior communication and disputes. Define how records match the correct account and which source holds the latest status. The output A summary of the amount due, recorded payments, recent follow-up and disputes, with a question or message draft for the next step. Unconfirmed information stays visible to the reviewer. An illustrative example A fictional invoice is due, but an unresolved dispute is recorded. The summary flags the dispute and returns it to the owner for clarification before a new demand is prepared. Review and acceptance Evaluate account separation, use of recorded payments and recognition of disputes. The responsible person approves contact, settlement or changes to terms under their assigned authority. Prepare an invoice follow-up brief

All solutions Customer-request context, ready for the team handling it. A service question differs from a change request or a complaint that needs a decision. We design workflows that distinguish these cases and prepare the answer, information or handoff the team needs. Custom workflow design and development Understand the request Identify the request type, available information and its source. If an order reference or essential detail is missing, prepare a clarification before proposing an action. Answer or handoff The output might be an answer from an approved procedure, a clarification question or a handoff explaining the customer’s request, what has been checked and what the specialist team needs to do. Language and detail Review Arabic and English against representative requests. Preserve names, request identifiers and dates, with the same terms and commitments in both languages. Decision boundaries Refunds, account changes and binding schedule changes need an authorized owner. Define handoff conditions and the context employees need before connecting an execution tool. Prepare a customer-request brief
